adults.prompt: Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET, transparent background, exactly 4 columns and 6 rows of 24 separated equal square cells. Reference is identity/style reference ONLY; redraw poses, do not copy its repeated leg poses. Keep the SAME two people, outfits, colors, clean dark ink outlines, warm cel-painted cartoon game style. No text, labels, panels, ground, shadows, speed lines or shared elements across cells. All bodies move LEFT. First character occupies cells 0-11 (first three rows), second cells 12-23 (last three rows). Per character: 0-7 = eight DISTINCT chronologically ordered sprint cycle poses, near leg passing forward and far leg passing backward then exchanging, two opposite extended contact poses and two tucked airborne poses. Clear separation of boots and bent knees, visible alternating feet under skirt where applicable, opposite arm swing, forward lean, small body bob. In first four run poses head and eyes face LEFT toward escape; in next four glances over right shoulder. 8 = stops, turns to viewer, raises open palm warning STOP; 9 = trips forward, hands reaching ground, both knees bent; 10 = on one knee pushing self upright; 11 = stands leaning right arm extended down to pull another person up, only this one person in cell. Keep head/body dimensions absolutely constant across all 12 poses; no extra characters. Exactly 24 images, generous transparent gutters, full bodies uncropped.
